adjudication.rationale: In `app/views/embed/loading.html.erb` the page unconditionally `document.location.reload()` every 30000ms with no cap. Each reload hits `EmbedController#best`, and when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` is nil it always `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` and renders loading again. The `RetrieveTopic` job calls `TopicRetriever#retrieve`, which only throttles the expensive work (`perform_retrieve`) via a 60s redis key, but does not prevent repeated enqueuing. After the throttle expires, `perform_retrieve` will again run `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` (if enabled) and then `fetch_http` (`TopicEmbed.import_remote`), so a never-successful import results in indefinite repeated polling/fetching.
